title: LAMB: A Modern Contextual Language Model for Latin
abstract: arXiv:2610.31723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This article introduces Latin Modern BERT (LAMB), an encoder for the Latin language based on the ModernBERT architecture, pretrained in two phases on more than 74B Latin tokens using a novel morphologically informed masking regimen. We also present two corpora for the Latin language. Acervus contains 24B BERT WordPiece tokens, including over 760K samples from heavily damaged OCR transcriptions, repaired by a ByT5 model trained for Latin text repair. The second dataset, Corpus Trinum, contains a mixture of over 100M strong and weak Latin language semantic triplets. Corpus Trinum is the first Latin semantic triplet dataset, opening the door for Latin language models to be adapted to general sentence semantic similarity tasks. translated_title: LAMB：一个面向拉丁语的现代上下文语言模型
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了拉丁语现代BERT（LAMB），这是一个基于ModernBERT架构的拉丁语编码器，采用一种新颖的形态学感知掩码方案，分两个阶段在超过740亿个拉丁语词元上进行了预训练。我们还提出了两个拉丁语语料库。Acervus包含240亿个BERT WordPiece词元，其中包括超过76万个来自严重损坏的OCR转录的样本，这些样本由一个专为拉丁语文本修复训练的ByT5模型进行修复。第二个数据集Corpus Trinum包含超过1亿个强、弱拉丁语语义三元组的混合。Corpus Trinum是首个拉丁语语义三元组数据集，为拉丁语语言模型适配通用句子语义相似度任务打开了大门。我们构建了一个包含五个任务和十七个子任务的实验网格，对15个预训练编码器和6个LAMB训练检查点应用了多种微调配置和子词聚合技术……
tldr: 研究者基于ModernBERT架构，采用新颖的形态学感知掩码方案在740亿拉丁语词元上分两阶段预训练出LAMB编码器，并发布Acervus和首个拉丁语语义三元组数据集Corpus Trinum两个新语料库，为拉丁语语义相似度等下游任务奠定基础。
en_tdlr: The authors introduce LAMB, a ModernBERT-based Latin encoder pretrained in two phases on over 74B Latin tokens using a novel morphologically informed masking scheme, and release two new corpora—Acervus and Corpus Trinum, the first Latin semantic triplet dataset—enabling Latin language models for sentence semantic similarity tasks.
